verdict.rationale: Grafana's core is an open-source project on GitHub ([grafana-gh-1]), documented as "Grafana OSS and Enterprise" ([grafana-probe-2]) and licensed under AGPL ([grafana-comm-12], [grafana-comm-17]). It is configured via file-based provisioning ([grafana-docs-2]), and community users describe running their own instances, including storage backend choices and pinning versions ([grafana-comm-11], [grafana-comm-13], [grafana-comm-18]). Companion components also self-host as single binaries ([grafana-docs-29], [grafana-docs-54]), and the MCP server has a self-managed open-source option ([grafana-docs-7]). Missing for 10: explicit first-party installation/deployment docs for the Grafana server itself, plus clarity on which AI/Cloud features (e.g., Assistant) remain unavailable when self-hosted.
